about: What this system does, in its own words and under ids it owns. A fact changes when the system changes, never when a standard does. How a fact lands on a standard, and at which tier, lives in conformance/standards/<standard>.json and is computed by cmd/conformance.

mathematics.what: Ed25519, SHA-256, SHA-384, the RFC 6962 tree, RFC 8785 canonical form

intel.what: Intel's TDX attestation chain, the root of the quote

google-cloud.what: Google's hypervisor, disk encryption and signed firmware endorsement; a project owner can snapshot the disk (audit-logged)

google-kms.what: Google Cloud KMS holding #portal at software protection level

canonical.what: Canonical's word for the contents of the public image the boot log names

portal-key.what: Portal's capability key #portal, used by a sign-only service account on the Portal server

portal-webauthn.what: Portal verifying the operator's WebAuthn assertion; the gateway does not repeat it

osv.what: the OSV advisory data the hands read

hedera.what: Hedera consensus and mirror nodes; a public ledger whose nodes are run by a governing council

domain.what: the domain abovebeyond.ai and its DNS, for the did:webvh log

operator-token.what: the operator's YubiKeys (PIV 9c, PIN and touch), Yubico's key generation, and that hand.mjs is the tool the operator ran

facts.says: Every in-scope action was judged by the gateway and recorded before its effect was released.
facts.how: Signed evidence token per action, hash chain, RFC 6962 tree, record fsynced before the effect; FAIL_CLOSED when the store cannot be written.

facts.says: Each repository-changing action carried a certificate of premises that verifies against the material beside the record.
facts.how: ProveML certificate checked by the gateway before the grant is read; replayable by three independent verifiers.

facts.says: The chain head existed by the anchored time and has not been rewritten below the anchored size.
facts.how: Daily signed checkpoint, timestamped by DigiCert (RFC 3161) and posted to Hedera mainnet topic 0.0.10856156 by a keyless anchorer.

facts.says: The record names the agent by a fragment of a DID whose key history is signed.
facts.how: did:webvh log with pre-rotation, update key on a hardware token, every version pinned at DigiCert and on Hedera and compared back (anchor identity check).

facts.says: The gateway's key was generated inside an Intel TDX trust domain and bound in the quote; the quote's registers are held to published references, including every applied policy version in RTMR3.
facts.how: REPORTDATA binds the key; MRTD against Google's endorsement; RTMR0-2 replayed from the event log; RTMR3 folds the binary, the carried configuration and each policy version.

facts.says: Every action was performed on a capability the principal signed for that task, narrowing the standing grant.
facts.how: Ed25519 token over RFC 8785 payload, verified by the gateway and intersected with the grant; its digest and task on the record.

facts.says: A workbench action admitted on the token was admitted by the operator in person.
facts.how: Capability signed by #operator or #operator-2 on a YubiKey, verified against the DID log, re-verified by verify and by the far end.

facts.says: A workbench action admitted by passkey was admitted by the operator.
facts.how: Portal verifies the WebAuthn assertion and signs the capability with #portal; the assertion's digest and credential id ride in the capability.

facts.says: The rules the gateway judges by are a signed, numbered, forward-only log, and every record names the version it ran under.
facts.how: Versions signed by the operator's token (widen) or Elixir (narrow, only when the gateway finds it narrower); each applied version extended into RTMR3 before the first action under it.

facts.says: A capability the operator ends early is refused by the gateway within 30 seconds.
facts.how: The gateway polls Portal's list of capabilities ended early every 30 s; the list is unsigned because it can only take away.
facts.open: Reads on a B1 mandate go direct to the system and cannot be ended early; the systems do not read the list.

facts.says: A running system carries out an action only after verifying the gateway's record and the mandate itself, holding no credential of the gateway.
facts.how: Stocklist and the Gentells pipeline check the record's signature against the DID document, verdict, target, parameter digest, freshness, nonce and the mandate's jti.
facts.open: The systems read the TDX platform as a field in the signed record; they do not verify the quote.

facts.says: Before judging, the gateway holds the tail of its own log against the head it carries and stops on any disagreement; there is no override.
facts.how: FAIL_CLOSED on tail or head mismatch, recovery in docs/the-halt.md.

facts.says: A passkey approval can only fall inside a working set the operator signed on the token.
facts.how: Working set signed on the YubiKey; Portal refuses a passkey approval outside it.
facts.open: The gateway does not check the working set yet; only Portal enforces the bound.
